rounding: Thresholds use >= and < as written, after rounding to 9 places (qwen_updates.r9); a missing value is a miss. 'within' and 'to' bands include their ends.

readings.delta_r: Over H's mixed problems (both right and wrong samples at W0): the mean over problems of (mean change in summed response log-prob of the problem's right samples minus that of its wrong ones), W_t minus W0, fp32. Right = reward 1. An empty pool has no reading.
readings.kl: Mean per-token KL(pi_0 || pi_t) over all H samples' response tokens, fp32.
readings.gain: Greedy strict accuracy, last step minus step 0, drop rule, paired over problems whose answers fit the window at both; SE = sd of the per-problem differences / sqrt n.
readings.reward: 1 if the strict grader is right and the response ended inside the window (prompt plus response <= 512), else 0.

P0.fail: stop; an empty readout pool also stops

P2.rule: d = RL's GSM1k gain minus its GSM8K gain, SE of d in quadrature (independent sets). same if |d| < same_below and |d| <= se_mult SE; GSM8K-only if -d >= only_min and -d >= se_mult SE; ambiguous otherwise.

P4.rule: R's delta_r > 0 at every saved step, and R's delta_r >= ratio x |N's delta_r| at ratio_steps (N's at its last step if cut).

P5.withdrawn: Withdrawn before filing: the old 'KL(1) < 1e-4' band was a guess; E45's own recorded step reads 0.0056.

P7.rule: F's KL(100) >= kl_ratio x R's KL(100), and F's GSM8K gain <= R's.
P7.expected: uncertain on the first part; reported either way

early.rollouts_identical: R step 1, N step 1 and F's first batch equal token for token
early.finite: loss and gradient norm finite at every step
early.amended: 2026-11-03, before any scored run: sampler_se_mult 2 -> 3. The sampler check is two 2-SE tests (length, reward); with the sampler correct they falsely stop the run about 9% of the time, and a stop parks a billing pod (review 2026-11-03, finding 5).

cost.rule: projected R + N + F over usd_max: N runs 50 steps; still over: stop and report

tree.P0 fails: stop, fix the cause, rerun A0
tree.R1 P1 learns or ambiguous: dWs go to qwen-decomp-lead, ambiguous labelled weak; then anchor 1 at E61's rate
tree.R2 P1 no gain: one rerun of R at lr 3e-6 (Amendment 1); still no gain: card, the harder-benchmark search
tree.R3 reward falls by 0.05 by step 20: stop before N and F; one rerun of R at lr 3e-7 (Amendment 1); FYI
tree.P3 fails: FYI; the null's dW is still read; the reading of RL carries the gap as its noise floor
tree.P6 fails: card: answers lengthen past the window; dWs kept and scored
tree.P2 GSM8K-only: FYI, an analysis line; the plan goes on
